He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas Jayhawks]], and was selected by the Raptors with the 13th overall selection in the [[2023 NBA draft]]. Dick was awarded the 2022 [[Gatorade Player of the Year awards|Gatorade National Player of the Year]] in high school. ==High school career== Dick started high school at [[Wichita Collegiate School]] in [[Wichita, Kansas]], where he spent two years. In his final year with the school, he averaged 20 points a game while reaching the state playoffs.{{Cite web |last=Kradle |first=Adam |date=July 1, 2020 |title=Kansas basketball star Gradey Dick has two years of high school left, but is already a high-level DI recruit |url=https://bvmsports.com/2020/07/01/kansas-basketball-star-gradey-dick-has-two-years-of-high-school-left-but-is-already-a-high-level-di-recruit/ |access-date=June 8, 2022 |website=BVM Sports |language=en-US}} He subsequently transferred to Sunrise Christian Academy. He played two years for the school, averaging 18 points a game in his senior year.{{Cite web |last=Peek |first=Krysten |date=March 22, 2022 |title=Kansas commit Gradey Dick wins Gatorade National Boys Basketball Player of the Year |url=https://sports.yahoo.com/kansas-commit-gradey-dick-wins-gatorade-national-boys-basketball-player-of-the-year-203120510.html |access-date=June 8, 2022 offers from [[Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball|Kansas]], [[Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball|Iowa State]] and [[Baylor Bears men's basketball|Baylor]], among others, during his first two years of high school.{{Cite web |last=Tait |first=Matt |date=April 28, 2020 |title=Class of 2022 Kansas target Gradey Dick transferring to Sunrise Academy [[college recruiting|recruit]] during his tenure with Sunrise Christian Academy. On March 31, 2023, Dick declared for the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{Cite web |last=Givony |first=Jonathan |date=March 31, 2023 |title=Kansas freshman Gradey Dick to enter NBA draft |url=https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/36019182 |access-date=December 11, 2024 |website=ESPN}} ==Professional career== The [[Toronto Raptors]] selected Dick with the thirteenth overall pick in the [[2023 NBA draft]].{{cite web|url=https://clutchpoints.com/gradey-dick-raptors-no-13-pick-2023-nba-draft|title=Gradey Dick: Meet the Raptors' No. 13 pick in 2023 NBA Draft|last=Siegel|first=Brett|website=ClutchPoints|date=June 22, 2023|access-date=June 24, 2023}} He made his [[2023 NBA Summer League]] debut on July 7 against the [[Chicago Bulls]] with ten points, four rebounds and two assists in a 83–74 loss.{{Cite web |date=2023-07-08 |title=Raptors' Gradey Dick: Struggles in debut |url=https://www.cbssports.com/fantasy/basketball/news/raptors-gradey-dick-struggles-in-debut/ |access-date=2023-07-09 |website=CBSSports.com |language=en}} On July 15, 2023, Dick recorded 21 points, 5 rebounds and 2 steals to help the Toronto Raptors win 108–101 against the [[Golden State Warriors]] in his fifth Summer League game.{{cite web |date=July 15, 2023 |title=Warriors 101-108 Raptors (July 15, 2023) Box Score -ESPN |url=https://www.espn.com/nba-summer-league/boxscore/_/gameId/401558293/league/nba-summer-las-vegas |access-date=July 16, 2023 |website=ESPN |language=en}} On November 23, 2023, the Raptors assigned Dick to the [[Raptors 905]] of the [[NBA G League]].{{Cite web |date=November 24, 2023 |title=Raptors assign first-round pick Gradey Dick to Raptors 905 |url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/raptors-assign-first-round-pick-gradey-dick-to-raptors-905/ |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=Sportsnet.ca |language=en}} In his first game against [[Capital City Go-Go]], Dick shot 1 for 12, missing all six three-pointers, and had three turnovers in a 115–101 loss.{{Cite web |last=Smith |first=Doug |date=2023-11-25 |title=Raptors rookie Gradey Dick 'couldn't throw anything in the ocean' in G League debut. He'll get another shot |url=https://www.thestar.com/sports/raptors/raptors-rookie-gradey-dick-couldn-t-throw-anything-in-the-ocean-in-g-league-debut/article_cad4487a-ac3a-525f-aecb-bd2b75257b6e.html |access-date=2023-11-25 |website=Toronto Star |language=en}} Dick bounced back on December 1, 2023, with a strong winning performance against the Maine Celtics. He shot 7 for 14 and made 4-of-7 three-pointers in a strong 21-point performance. It was the Raptors 905's first win of the season.{{Cite web |url=https://stats.gleague.nba.com/game/2052300120/ |access-date=2023-12-01 |website=NBA G League |language=en |title=MNE vs RAP }} On March 27, 2024, during a 145–101 blowout loss against the [[New York Knicks]], Dick scored a then-career-high 23 points.{{cite web|title= Knicks cruise past Raptors in most lopsided home loss in Toronto's history|url= https://www.tsn.ca/new-york-knicks-cruise-past-toronto-raptors-in-most-lopsided-home-loss-in-toronto-s-history-1.2096170?tsn-amp|date= March 27, 2024|access-date=March 28, 2024|website=tsn.ca}} On April 10, 2024, during a 106–102 loss against the [[Brooklyn Nets]], Dick scored a then-career-high 24 points.{{cite web |date=April 10, 2024 |title=Gradey Dick scores career-high 24 points in Raptors' loss to Nets |url=https://www.sportsnet.ca/nba/dick-scores-career-high-24-points-in-raptors-loss-to-nets/sn-amp/ |access-date=April 10, 2024 |website=sportsnet.ca |agency=Associated Press}} On October 26, 2024, during a 112–101 loss against the [[Minnesota Timberwolves]], Dick scored a then-career-high 25 points.{{cite web|first=Frank|last=Zicarelli|title=Raptors' growing pains continue in road loss to Timberwolves|url=https://torontosun.com/sports/basketball/nba/toronto-raptors/raptors-growing-pains-continue-in-road-loss-to-timberwolves|website=torontosun.com|date=October 26, 2024|access-date=October 26, 2024}} On October 30, Dick scored a then-career-high 30 points in a 138–133 loss to the [[Charlotte Hornets]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401704683|title=Tre Mann scores 27, Hornets get 72 points from their bench to beat Raptors 138-133 for 1st home win|website=ESPN|date=October 31, 2024|access-date=November 14, 2024}} On November 1, Dick scored a then-career-high 31 points in a 131–125 loss to the [[Los Angeles Lakers]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401704703|title=Davis scores season-high 38, Lakers beat Raptors 131-125 for first road win of the season|website=ESPN|date=November 2, 2024|access-date=November 14, 2024}} On November 12, Dick scored a career-high 32 points against the [[Milwaukee Bucks]].{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/nba/recap/_/gameId/401703374|title=Antetokounmpo scores 23 to lead Bucks past Raptors 99-85 in matchup of NBA's worst|website=ESPN|date=November 13, 2024|access-date=November 14, 2024}} He started 54 games for Toronto during the [[2024–25 NBA season]], averaging 14.4 points, 3.6 rebounds, and 1.8 assists. On April 4, 2025, Dick was ruled out for the remainder of the season due to a lingering right knee injury.{{cite web | last=Rose | first=Aaron | title=Raptors Provide Update on Gradey Dick's Heath Status | website=Yardbarker | date=2025-04-04 | url=https://www.yardbarker.com/nba/articles/raptors_provide_update_on_gradey_dicks_heath_status/s1_16610_42005818 | access-date=2025-12-08}} ==National team career== Dick represented the [[United States men's national under-18 3x3 team|United States]] at the [[2021 FIBA 3x3 U18 World Cup – Men's tournament|2021 FIBA 3x3 Under-18 World Cup]] in [[Debrecen]], Hungary. His teammates were [[Kyle Filipowski]], [[Keyonte George]] and [[Eric Dailey Jr.]] Dick averaged 3.2 points, helping his team win the gold medal.{{Cite web |last=Tait |first=Matt |date=August 30, 2021 |title=KU commitment Gradey Dick brings home gold medal with Team USA at 3-on-3 World Cup |url=https://www2.kusports.com/weblogs/tale-tait/2021/aug/30/ku-commitment-gradey-dick-brings-home-go/ [[2022–23 Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball team|Kansas]] || 36 || 36 || 32.7|| .442 || .403 || .854 || 5.1 || 1.7 || 1.4 || .3 || 14.1 {{S-end}} ==Personal life== Dick was born in [[Wichita, Kansas]], to Bart and Carmen Dick. His mother played [[Women's College Basketball|college basketball]] for [[Iowa State Cyclones women's basketball|Iowa State]].{{Cite web |last=Olson |first=Eric |date=March 18, 2023 |title=Jayhawks' March Madness star gets basketball genes from mom |url=https://apnews.com/article/march-madness-kansas-arkansas-northwestern-ucla-02f2e9adbbdb7f474ee5ce6b6f95105e |access-date=December 11, 2024 |website=AP News |language=en-US}} He is a Christian and has said, "I was given, fortunately, all these blessings in my life, and that's kind of my hand, and I'm trying to do the best I can do with it and glorify God while I'm doing it."{{cite web|last=Doering|first=Joshua|title=Gradey Dick playing key role for No. 4 Kansas as he aims 'to make Him proud'|url=https://sportsspectrum.com/sport/basketball/2022/12/20/gradey-dick-kansas-make-him-proud/|website=Sports Spectrum|date=December 20, 2022 |access-date=December 22, 2022}} On July 17, 2023, Dick signed a multi-year deal with [[Adidas]]. He has also starred in commercials for [[Gillette]].{{Cite web |last=Laddha |first=Shreyas |date=July 17, 2023 |title=Now in NBA, former KU Jayhawks basketball star Gradey Dick signs contract with Adidas |url=https://www.kansascity.com/sports/college/big-12/university-of-kansas/article277400263.html |access-date=December 11, 2024 |website=kansascity.com}} He also has a podcast called Welcome Party on [[Bleacher Report]]. ==References== {{Reflist}} ==External links== * [https://kuathletics.com/sports/mbball/roster/season/2022-23/player/gradey-dick/ Kansas Jayhawks bio] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231204154303/https://kuathletics.com/sports/mbball/roster/season/2022-23/player/gradey-dick/ |date=December 4, 2023 }} * [https://web.archive.org/web/20200812115726/https://www.usab.com/basketball/players/mens/d/dick-gradey.aspx USA Basketball Bio] (archived) * {{FIBA|name=Gradey Dick}} * {{FIBA 3x3|name=Gradey Reed Dick}} {{Toronto Raptors current roster}} {{2023 NBA draft}} {{Gatorade National Basketball Player of the Year}} {{Portal bar|Basketball|Kansas}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Dick, Gradey}} [[Category:2003 births]] [[Category:Living people]] [[Category:21st-century American sportsmen]] [[Category:American expatriate basketball people in Canada]] [[Category:American men's 3x3 basketball players]] [[Category:American men's basketball players]] [[Category:Basketball players from Wichita, Kansas]] [[Category:Christians from Kansas]] [[Category:Kansas Jayhawks men's basketball players]] [[Category:McDonald's High School All-Americans]] [[Category:Raptors 905 players]] [[Category:Small forwards]] [[Category:Toronto Raptors draft picks]] [[Category:Toronto Raptors players]] [[Category:Sunrise Christian Academy alumni]] [[Category:American basketball podcasters]]
